details: Archimedes: buoyant force equals the weight of displaced water; a 70 kg person needs about 70 liters of displacement in fresh water.
Foam buoyancy is fixed at manufacture: volume times (water density minus foam density) times gravity.
Salt water (1025 kg/m3) floats you slightly better than fresh (1000 kg/m3); cold water adds other problems.
Self-righting needs the buoyancy placed high on the chest and behind the head, not evenly spread.
